description: Remove a claim from a project's register for good, with what it rests on — it cannot be undone, so do it only when the person asked for this very one to be deleted; confirm its label with them first. Its journal keeps its lines and one that it was deleted. A claim that turned out false is not deleted: set_claim_status 'refuted' or 'retracted' keeps it said. Members of the project who may write only.

id.description: The claim, as list_claims returned it.
